scenarios.title: Blood Moor to Cold Plains: the hero walks the exit and arrives (exit refusal baseline, knobs OFF then ON via D2SCEN_KNOBS)
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 8, purse 1500, field start in the Blood Moor by debug goto 2 (CHEATED position). Mechanics only.
scenarios.notes: Run twice per class and seed: defaults, then D2SCEN_KNOBS=nav.warpRead=1,nav.fullGrid=1. The evidence is the count of 'unwanted exit' and 'mouth gate' lines in the bot log next to the verdict (run 6208 and c261 never produced a refusal in the Blood Raven scenario; the refusal of the fresh drill happened on this walk). U: the farm goal walks to Cold Plains first.

assert.why: the hero crossed into Cold Plains (or went on from it / back to town)

scenarios.title: Standing in the Barracks: walk back up to the Outer Cloister (the return leg of the Monastery road)
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 26, gold 3000, potions, field start in the Barracks (area 28) by debug goto 28 (CHEATED position). Mechanics only.
scenarios.notes: The return leg of the stage 1 failure (run 20261123-023115-028d: from the Barracks `nav no usable gate from 28 to 27`, `border not readable from here, walking to its strip`). Goal: leave the Barracks for the Outer Cloister. The forward leg is the toolstrade work (act1.tools.*).

assert.why: the hero walked back up out of the Barracks

scenarios.pending_reason: a field start by debug goto puts the hero at (65,212), far from the arrival strip, and the planner finds no plan to the unproven strip from there (RED for Paladin and Necromancer, run 20261123-033306, with and without the fix); the real shape (arrival from the Outer Cloister, the strip reached, d2d still cannot read across) is covered by TestExitToCrossesAnUnprovenStripThatNeverProves. Needs a start that arrives by walking from the Outer Cloister. The real arrival shape is now a unit test on the live Barracks capture (TestExitToCrossesTheLiveBarracksSouthStrip, level 28 grid of 2026-11-23, hero at (191,324), strip x 179..182 of row 349); a scenario from a walked arrival stays open.

scenarios.title: Standing in the Inner Cloister: walk north to the Cathedral (the Cathedral is a border link d2d links only near its edge)
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 24, field start in the Inner Cloister (area 32) by debug goto 32 (CHEATED position). Mechanics only.
scenarios.notes: V live 2026-11-24 (Andariel try-anyway, deploy 62): Inner Cloister to Cathedral, `nav no usable gate from 32 to 33`, exits 1 (the warp to Jail 3 only), adjacent 0, pending 1, three times. The lab warps list of level 32 has one warp too (tools/probes/warptrig.py, devp27); the Cathedral is 34 tiles north and linked only near the edge (strips.py: side N, verdict open). Fix: an unlinked neighbour keeps its strip as unproven (internal/d2dworld/border.go).

assert.why: the hero walked north out of the Inner Cloister into the Cathedral

scenarios.title: Standing in area 33: take the stairs down to Catacombs Level 1 (a hop of the Andariel route)
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 30, field start in area 33 by debug goto (CHEATED position). Mechanics only. Life raised to 1500 by stat write (CHEATED): the crowd of Catacombs 2 and 3 kills a clvl 30 hero with 300 life before the hop, which says nothing about the exit.
scenarios.notes: Pre-check of the Andariel route (2026-11-24): lab warps list of level 33 has the stairs to 34 (tools/probes/exitsread.py, devp27, seed 11). Real ExitTo through the exit.
